Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the IMFDB Westworld Season 1 page and incorrectly concluded that the Man in Black (Ed Harris) used a Remington 1875, despite earlier credible evidence indicating a custom LeMat revolver. This conflated weapons listed for other characters with Ed Harris’s sidearm and contradicted the already-surfaced IMFDB snippet stating he holds a custom LeMat, leading the process toward the wrong solution.
